name: MiniMax-M1
attention_variant: hybrid: lightning (linear) attention on 70 layers + full GQA on 10 layers
notes: The first large-scale open-weight hybrid-attention reasoning model, and the origin of MiniMax's distinctive attention pattern. Vendor: 456B total / 45.9B activated; safetensors total 456.09B. config layer_types over 80 layers: 70 linear_attention + 10 full_attention - lightning attention interleaved one full layer in eight. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 10 full-attention layers x 8 kv_heads x head_dim 128 x 2 x 2 bytes = 10 x 8 x 128 x 2 x 2 = 40,960 B/token (40 KiB). If all 80 layers were full attention it would be 654,240 B/token (639 KiB) - so the hybrid pattern buys a 16x KV reduction. MoE: 32 local experts, only 2 per token (num_experts_per_tok 2) - an unusually low top-k, and the main reason active params are 45.9B rather than something smaller. hidden 6144, intermediate 9216, vocab ~200k. rotary_dim 64 (partial RoPE). postnorm true. Context: max_position_embeddings 10240000 - an order of magnitude beyond anything else in this slice, built for very long RL/test-time-compute runs. rope_theta 10000000. M1 also ships per-layer alpha/beta scaling factors (mlp_alpha_factor, full_attn_alpha_factor, linear_attn_alpha_factor, all 3.5566) - a MiniMax-specific feature not seen elsewhere. Apache-2.0, notably more permissive than the M2 line's non-commercial terms.
